title: Final reindexing preserves first-page comparison
statement:
theorem reindex_first_page_comparison
{I : Type u} [SmallCategory I] {J : Type (u + 1)} [SmallCategory J]
    (R : J ⥤ I) (hR : R.Final)
    (E : I ⥤ SpectralSequence AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
      (fun r ↦ ComplexShape.up' (⟨1 - r, r⟩ : ℤ × ℤ)) 1)
    (E' : SpectralSequence AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
      (fun r ↦ ComplexShape.up' (⟨1 - r, r⟩ : ℤ × ℤ)) 1)
    (v : ∀ i, E.obj i ⟶ E')
    (hcomp : ∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j), E.map f ≫ v j = v i)
    (hfirst : ∀ (s t : ℤ)
      (ψ : colimit (E ⋙ SpectralSequence.pageFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
        (fun r ↦ ComplexShape.up' (⟨1 - r, r⟩ : ℤ × ℤ)) 1 1 ⋙
        HomologicalComplex.eval _ _ ⟨s, t⟩) ⟶ (E'.page 1).X ⟨s, t⟩),
      (∀ i, colimit.ι _ i ≫ ψ = ((v i).hom 1 (by omega)).f ⟨s, t⟩) → IsIso ψ) :
    ∀ (s t : ℤ)
      (ψ : colimit ((R ⋙ E) ⋙ SpectralSequence.pageFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
        (fun r ↦ ComplexShape.up' (⟨1 - r, r⟩ : ℤ × ℤ)) 1 1 ⋙
        HomologicalComplex.eval _ _ ⟨s, t⟩) ⟶ (E'.page 1).X ⟨s, t⟩),
      (∀ j, colimit.ι _ j ≫ ψ = ((v (R.obj j)).hom 1 (by omega)).f ⟨s, t⟩) → IsIso ψ

source.place: Tags 0032, 015J, 015K and 0EZM; functorial first-page and abutment construction

proof.text: Evaluate the spectral diagram at page one and the given bidegree. The compatible maps define a cocone Q. Its colimit descent is an isomorphism by hfirst. Finality makes colimit.pre A R an isomorphism. Colimit hom-extensionality and the leg equations identify psi with colimit.pre A R followed by colimit.desc A Q, hence psi is an isomorphism.

proof_origin.place: Tag 0032; Mathlib Functor.Final.colimit_pre_isIso, colimit.ι_pre and colimit.ι_desc
